commands_and_checks.purpose: Prove producer-handoff lease release, independent N4 readiness, consumer fail-closed gating, and post-N12 integration reacquisition
criteria: N3 FROZEN with report and hashes releases LEASE-GENESIS-CONTRACT before N4 READY; N4 own verdict is not a release input
N4 FAIL or non-ACCEPTED never unlocks N5, N6, N7, or N9; accepted N4 is required
LEASE-GENESIS-INTEGRATION is acquired only after accepted N12-G1-PREINTEGRATION
commands_and_checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('docs/plans/2026-09-21-meeting-intelligence-task-dag.json','utf8'));const node=id=>p.nodes.find(n=>n.id===id);const lease=id=>p.serialized_leases.find(l=>l.id===id);const n4=node('N4-G1-CONTRACT');const consumers=['N5-LT-WORKER','N6-KE-WORKER','N7-SI-API-WORKER','N9-EXTERNAL-APPROVAL'];const contract=lease('LEASE-GENESIS-CONTRACT');const integration=lease('LEASE-GENESIS-INTEGRATION');const has=(v,s)=>String(v||'').includes(s);if(!has(contract.release_condition,'N3-LOCAL-CONTRACT-SCHEMA')||!has(contract.release_condition,'FROZEN')||!has(contract.release_condition,'report')||!has(contract.release_condition,'hashes')||!has(contract.release_condition,'before N4-G1-CONTRACT')||has(contract.release_condition,'N4-G1-CONTRACT is FROZEN'))throw new Error('producer release invariant');if(!has(contract.snapshot_custody_after_release,'immutable')||!has(contract.snapshot_custody_after_release,'no writer'))throw new Error('snapshot custody invariant');if(!has(n4.readiness_condition,'LEASE-GENESIS-CONTRACT is RELEASED')||!has(n4.readiness_condition,'not an input'))throw new Error('N4 readiness invariant');if(!consumers.every(id=>{const n=node(id);return n.depends_on.includes('N4-G1-CONTRACT')&&has(n.required_predecessor_state,'must be ACCEPTED')&&has(n.required_predecessor_state,'FAIL')}))throw new Error('consumer gate invariant');if(!has(integration.acquisition_condition,'N12-G1-PREINTEGRATION')||!has(integration.acquisition_condition,'ACCEPTED'))throw new Error('integration reacquisition invariant');console.log('LEASE_READINESS_OK')"

Future code nodes must provide add-only migration and durable rollback before acquiring the Genesis or protected integration leases.
A delivery uncertainty is reconciled through provider receipt/idempotency evidence, not blind retry.
Public gateway cleanup must revoke its own lease/capability and must not clean up or inherit LAN FUNGWIRE authority.
